cmd_crew_add_key_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when authorized_keys cannot be written.
cmd_crew_apt_empty: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when playwright's dry run prints no output.
cmd_crew_apt_extra: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when playwright's dry run says everything is installed and then prints more. {text} is the extra line, quoted. The quoted sentence is playwright's own English output; keep it.
cmd_crew_apt_implausible: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when the announced count is zero or far too large. {count} is the number.
cmd_crew_apt_mismatch: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when the announced count differs from the list. {count} is the announced number, {listed} the listed one.
cmd_crew_apt_not_package: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when a line of playwright's dependency list is not a package name. {text} is the line, quoted.
cmd_crew_apt_package_count: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when the package list to install is empty or far too long.
cmd_crew_apt_unreadable: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when playwright's dry run prints a header Atlas does not know. {text} is the line, quoted.
cmd_crew_ask_export: Prompt of `atlas crew uninstall` (the answer is typed after it). Enter alone means yes. pt-BR answers with s (sim).
cmd_crew_ask_secrets: Prompt of the export `atlas crew uninstall` offers (the answer is typed after it). Enter alone means no. pt-BR answers with s (sim).
cmd_crew_asset_no_binary: Error of `atlas crew install` when the downloaded archive has no atlas executable. {asset} is the file name.
cmd_crew_bad_crewmate_id: Cause line of `atlas crew login --crewmate` for a bad id or agent.
cmd_crew_bad_version: Error of `atlas crew update <version>`. {example} is this CLI's version.
cmd_crew_browsers_capture_ready: Success line of `atlas crew browsers status`. {version} is the pinned playwright version.
cmd_crew_browsers_ready: Success line of `atlas crew browsers install`.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_apt: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install` before apt-get runs. {count} is how many system libraries it installs.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_deps: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install`.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_deps_ready: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install` when nothing is missing.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_dir: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install`.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_download: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install`.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_node: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install`.
cmd_crew_browsers_step_npm: Progress line of `atlas crew browsers install`. {version} is the pinned playwright version.
cmd_crew_cannot_reach: Error of `atlas crew browsers` when ssh fails. {target} is the SSH target, {reason} ssh's own message (English).
cmd_crew_cannot_reach_bare: Error of `atlas crew browsers status` when ssh fails and said nothing more.
cmd_crew_check_failed: Error of `atlas crew browsers status` when the check script printed nothing and failed.
cmd_crew_check_failed_reason: Error of `atlas crew browsers status` when the check script failed. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_command_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when one command run on the server fails. {command} is the command (cut at 120 characters), {reason} the server's own message.
cmd_crew_download_here_failed: Warning of `atlas crew install` when the local download fails and the cache is used. {reason} is the error.
cmd_crew_download_task_failed: Cause line of `atlas crew install` when the background download task cannot finish.
cmd_crew_enable_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when `systemctl enable` fails.
cmd_crew_engine_missing: Warning of `atlas crew install` when an engine's installer fails on the server. {agent} is the engine id, {reason} the installer's last line or the fallback, {line} the vendor's install command. i18n-allow glossary:agent
cmd_crew_export_exists: Error of `atlas crew export` when the output file exists.
cmd_crew_export_failed: Error of `atlas crew export` for any other failure. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_export_unreadable: Error of `atlas crew export` when the written archive does not open. {reason} is the reader's own message.
cmd_crew_exported: Success line of `atlas crew export`. {count} is how many crewmates went into the file, {target} the SSH target, {path} the file.
cmd_crew_fail_apt_install: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when installing the system libraries fails.
cmd_crew_fail_capture_dir: Error of `atlas crew browsers install`. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_fail_install_deps: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when the dry run of the dependency check fails.
cmd_crew_fail_npm_ci: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when npm ci fails.
cmd_crew_fail_playwright_install: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` when the browser download fails.
cmd_crew_fail_write_file: Error of `atlas crew browsers install` and `crew update` when a file of the capture runner cannot be written. {file} is the file name.
cmd_crew_get_binary_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` and `update` when no way to get the binary onto the server works. {on_host} and {here} are the two errors (English, shown as is), {path} the cache path.
cmd_crew_gone: Line after an unattended `atlas crew uninstall` that deleted data. {home} is the folder, {target} the SSH target, {count} the crewmates it held.
cmd_crew_gone_none: Line after an unattended `atlas crew uninstall` when there was no data.
cmd_crew_host_download_failed: Warning of `atlas crew install` and `update` when the server cannot download the release. {reason} is the server's last error line or the no-reason text.
cmd_crew_hostd_version_mismatch: Warning of `atlas crew update` when hostd answers with another version than the one installed. {got} and {want} are versions.
cmd_crew_import_failed: Error of `atlas crew import` for any other failure. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_import_summary: Line of `atlas crew import` before it sends the archive. {file} is the archive, {count} the crewmates in it, {version} the atlas that wrote it.
cmd_crew_import_summary_secrets: Same line as the import summary when the archive includes secrets.
cmd_crew_install_binary_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when swapping the binary fails. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_install_ready: Last line of `atlas crew install`. {account} is user@host.
cmd_crew_installer_failed: Reason used when an engine's installer fails without printing a message. Goes in {reason} of the engine warning.
cmd_crew_key_missing: Cause line of `atlas crew install --identity` when the key file is missing.
cmd_crew_link_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when the symlink in the crew user's home cannot be made.
cmd_crew_list_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when the existing crewmates cannot be listed.
cmd_crew_login_install_first: Line of `atlas crew login`; the vendor's install command follows on its own line. i18n-allow glossary:agent
cmd_crew_login_opening: Line of `atlas crew login`. {command} is the ssh command line.
cmd_crew_login_opening_crewmate: Line of `atlas crew login --crewmate`. {id} is the crewmate id, {command} the ssh command line.
cmd_crew_migration_notice: Line of `atlas crew install` after a migration to one Linux user per crewmate. {count} is how many crewmates moved.
cmd_crew_missing_tools: One line of the list in the error of `atlas crew install`: the tools the server lacks. {tools} is a comma-separated list of program names.
cmd_crew_missing_tools_install: Second line under the missing tools: the exact command for Debian and Ubuntu. {packages} is a space-separated list of package names.
cmd_crew_name_mismatch: Reply of `atlas crew uninstall` when the typed name does not match.
cmd_crew_no_crew_user: Goes in {home} of the uninstall list when the server has no crew user.
cmd_crew_no_reason_given: Filler in a `crew install` error when the server printed nothing useful about why writing a systemd unit failed. Goes in {why} of the two messages below.
cmd_crew_no_ssh_key: Cause line of `atlas crew install` when this machine has no SSH key to authorize.
cmd_crew_no_systemd: One line of the list in the error of `atlas crew install` when the server has no systemd.
cmd_crew_not_a_crew_server: Error of `atlas crew update` on a host with no crew service.
cmd_crew_not_ready: First line of the error of `atlas crew install` when the server lacks something; the list of problems follows, one per line. {target} is the SSH target.
cmd_crew_old_dir_not_removed: Warning of `atlas crew install` on a migrated server when the old install folder cannot be deleted.
cmd_crew_pair_code: Row under the QR code of `atlas crew pair`: the pairing code. Aligned with the link row by the spaces here.
cmd_crew_pair_expires: Last paragraph of `atlas crew pair`. {host} is the server's host name.
cmd_crew_pair_failed: Error of `atlas crew pair`. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_pair_link: Row under the QR code of `atlas crew pair`: the pairing link. {url} is a link, keep it.
cmd_crew_pair_no_invite: Cause line of `atlas crew pair` when the server's output has no invite.
cmd_crew_pair_open: First line under the QR code of `atlas crew pair`. "Add a computer" is the label of the phone app, which is not translated yet: keep it as it is.
cmd_crew_pause_failed: Error of `atlas crew pause`. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_probe_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when the first look at the server fails.
cmd_crew_reuse_user: Progress line of `atlas crew install` on a server installed as Atlas Bot, whose user is kept.
cmd_crew_ssh_launch_failed: Cause line of `atlas crew login` when the ssh program cannot start.
cmd_crew_ssh_unreachable: Error of every `atlas crew` command when ssh itself fails. {reason} is ssh's own message (English).
cmd_crew_step_creating_user: Progress line of `atlas crew install`. {user} is the Linux user name.
cmd_crew_step_isolation: Progress line of `atlas crew install`: how many crewmates the server already has. {count} is the number.
cmd_crew_step_preflight: Progress line of `atlas crew install`: the first look at the server.
cmd_crew_step_retire: Progress line of `atlas crew install` on a server installed as Atlas Bot.
cmd_crew_step_start: Progress line of `atlas crew install`. {service} is the systemd unit name. i18n-allow glossary:service
cmd_crew_sudo_needed_export: Error of `atlas crew export` when sudo needs a password.
cmd_crew_sudo_needed_import: Error of `atlas crew import` when sudo needs a password.
cmd_crew_sudo_password_rejected: Error when the sudo password given to atlas crew was refused.
cmd_crew_sudo_password_required: Error when the SSH user's sudo needs a password and none was given. {command} is the exact command to run in a terminal.
cmd_crew_sudo_stdin_failed: Cause line when the password piped by Atlas Desktop cannot be read.
cmd_crew_swap_no_previous: Error of `atlas crew install` when hostd does not start on a first install.
cmd_crew_swap_rolled_back: Error of `atlas crew install` when the new binary fails its health wait and the old one is back.
cmd_crew_temp_dir_failed: Cause line of `atlas crew install` when the local temp folder cannot be made.
cmd_crew_too_old_export: Error of `atlas crew export` when the server's atlas predates export.
cmd_crew_too_old_import: Error of `atlas crew import` when the server's atlas predates import.
cmd_crew_type_server_name: Prompt of `atlas crew uninstall` (the answer is typed after it). {name} is the host part of the SSH target.
cmd_crew_uninstall_needs_decision: Error of `atlas crew uninstall` with no terminal and no --yes.
cmd_crew_uninstall_no_user: Item of the uninstall list when no crewmate data was found. {home} is the home folder or the no-user text.
cmd_crew_uninstall_service: Item of the uninstall list (printed after `  - `).
cmd_crew_uninstall_signins: Last item of the uninstall list (printed after `  - `).
cmd_crew_uninstall_title: First line of the list `atlas crew uninstall` prints before it deletes.
cmd_crew_uninstall_user_crewmates: Item of the uninstall list when the crew user exists. {home} is its home, {count} the crewmates in it.
cmd_crew_uninstall_user_crewmates_size: Same item as the crew user line when the size of the home is known. {size} is a size such as 1.2G.
cmd_crew_unit_masked: Last line of a failed `atlas crew install` when systemd has the unit masked and Atlas could not unmask it. {unit} is the unit file name (atlas-crew.service), {why} the server's own last message, {command} the exact shell command to run on the server; keep all three as they are.
cmd_crew_unit_unmasked: Progress line of `atlas crew install` when a masked systemd unit was unmasked. {unit} is the unit file name.
cmd_crew_unit_write_failed: Last line of a failed `atlas crew install` when writing the systemd unit failed for any other reason. {unit} is the unit file name, {why} the server's own last message (English, shown as is).
cmd_crew_unknown_agent: Cause line of `atlas crew login` for an agent id that does not exist. {supported} is a comma-separated list of ids.
cmd_crew_unsupported_host: Error of `atlas crew install` and `update` when `uname -sm` of the server is not a supported Linux. {uname} is the server's own output.
cmd_crew_update_done: Success line of `atlas crew update`. {host} is the host name, {target} the SSH target.
cmd_crew_update_down: Error of `atlas crew update` when hostd is down after the rollback too.
cmd_crew_update_failed: Error of `atlas crew update` when the swap script fails. {reason} is the server's own message.
cmd_crew_update_rolled_back: Error of `atlas crew update` when the new binary fails its health wait and the old one is back.
cmd_crew_update_step_restart: Progress line of `atlas crew update`. i18n-allow glossary:service
cmd_crew_update_step_runner: Progress line of `atlas crew update` after the capture runner was rewritten.
cmd_crew_update_step_stage: Progress line of `atlas crew update`. {triple} is the release target such as x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
cmd_crew_upload_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` and `update` when streaming the binary over ssh fails.
cmd_crew_useradd_failed: Error of `atlas crew install` when useradd fails.
cmd_crew_version_ahead: Last line of `atlas crew status` when the server's atlas is newer than this CLI.
cmd_crew_version_behind: Last line of `atlas crew status` when the server's atlas is older than this CLI. {server} and {cli} are versions.
cmd_crew_version_current: Last line of `atlas crew status` when the server runs the same atlas as this CLI.
cmd_crew_version_unknown: Last line of `atlas crew status` when the server's version could not be read.
